domain_hint: S-duct inlet CFD predicting AIP pressure recovery and swirl versus wind tunnel data
ambiguity_notes:
- Mesh refinement/solution quality: slides claim <1% variation and GCI=0.7%, but listed PR changes Coarse→Fine are 1.3% and θRMS shifts 0.8%, with residual drift on coarse.
- Boundary/domain setup: stated 2D/4D inflow/outflow extents, but SU2 check used 0.5D/1.5D; inlet TI cited as 1% then adjusted to 3%.
- Validation conditions: asserted match to M=0.30, yet one medium run logged AIP Mach 0.35 before correction; test TI=5% not matched initially.
- Numerical scheme/order: declared second-order throughout, but restart used first-order upwind for 500 iterations.
- Modeling approach consistency: final metrics from steady RANS while URANS showed unsteadiness; applicability to unsteady swirl unclear.
- Uncertainty/sensitivity: claimed 50-sample Monte Carlo, but only 12-point LHS performed; seeds not fixed initially.
- Configuration management: Git tag provided, but porous K tweaks done via GUI outside version control.
